================================================================================
Comments
================================================================================

-- a comment
select 1;
// another comment
# a third comment
select /* a block
comment */ 2;

---

(source_file
  (comment)
  (select_statement
    (select
      (number)))
  (comment)
  (comment)
  (select_statement
    (select
      (comment)
      (number))))
